name: Shadcn Theme Editor
summary: Component and demo for editing shadcn/ui theme colors with a live preview of components and text styles.
description: A user-friendly component for managing and customizing theme colors in shadcn-based projects: the demo lets you experiment with color values (primary, secondary, accent, outline, destructive) and instantly preview how buttons, cards, dialogs, notifications and Tailwind text color utilities adapt. The entry URL redirects to shadcnthemeeditor.oimmi.com.
contains: visual editor for shadcn theme colors
live preview: buttons, cards, dialogs and other components
color roles: primary, secondary, accent, outline, destructive
text style preview for Tailwind text color utilities
demo includes account dialogs, notifications and toasts
